"""BEHAVIOR-1K limited-mode dish put-away episode controller."""
import json, os, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print('CONNECTED', r.base)
print('SPEC', json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
obs = r.get_obs(video='frames')
obs.save(str(OUT / '000_initial'))
print('INITIAL', obs.meta)
print('PROPRIO', obs.meta.get('proprio'))

def observe(seconds=0, video='frames'):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)
    return obs

def joints(rows, dt=0.2, note=''):
    global obs
    res = r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video='mp4', note=note)
    print('ACTION', res.meta)
    res.save(str(OUT / ('action_%03d' % (len(list(OUT.glob('action_*'))) + 1))))
    obs = res
    return res

def poses(rows, note=''):
    global obs
    res = r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), video='mp4', note=note)
    print('ACTION', res.meta)
    res.save(str(OUT / ('action_%03d' % (len(list(OUT.glob('action_*'))) + 1))))
    obs = res
    return res

def save_obs(tag='current'):
    obs.save(str(OUT / tag))
    print('SAVED', OUT / tag)

import json, os, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
